home.introP1: This Site. '…let the TRUTH be known' is specifically designed to be a source of truth, to give you clear direction. It is easy to navigate and to get the answers you are seeking after. The Word of God tells us, and the world is evidence, that we are in a spiritual battle; a battle for the souls of men.
home.introP2: Salvation is the most important issue that every human being in this world faces and our video clearly presents the truth, from Scripture, on 'How to be saved.' It gives you the truth without delving into every false doctrine, false religion, and false teacher.
home.introP3: We have an explanation of the Gospel of Christ in the form of tracts and video. They explain Salvation in a number of different languages. Also, for the new Christian there is a set of specific, easy to understand lessons called 'Foundations of Our Faith'. Then to help you understand the Bible more clearly, we have included more in-depth materials that can be trusted to teach the truth.
home.introP4: A 'Frequently Asked Questions' section gives short simple answers to the most often asked questions is also available, and will be added to, as our readers forward their questions to us through our Contact page. Our final authority is the Word of God which is the Foundation of our Faith and the basis of all truth. May you be blessed and a blessing to others as you grow in knowledge and understanding of God's Word.
home.introP5: Our intention on this site, 'Let the TRUTH be known…' is to make the truth readily accessible and reduce the confusion that surrounds Jesus Christ and the Scriptures. This is done by giving free and open access to materials which are honest, reliable and available for scrutiny and an excellent resource for personal study. Our priority is to make sure that a clear salvation message is available to whoever is seeking Biblical truth and the Gospel of Jesus Christ.
home.introVerse: "And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free." John 8:32
home.godsWillP1: God does not want anyone to go to Hell. He loves His creation but He is also a righteous and Holy God. He created the Earth and He created Man. God created man in His own image. "So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them." Genesis 1:27. "And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day." Genesis 1:31
home.godsWillP2: God wants all men and women to be saved and receive eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
home.godsWillV1: "The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance." 2 Peter 3:9
home.godsWillP3: Repentance is a change of mind to believing and receiving Jesus Christ as your personal Saviour. "But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:" John 1:12
home.godsWillV2: "For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation." Romans 10:10
home.godsWillV3: "For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved." Romans 10:13
home.godsWillV4: "And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life." 1John 2:25

thankYou.title: THANK YOU
thankYou.p1: I hope you enjoy our site
thankYou.p2: Our simple purpose, is to bypass the confusion and deception that 'Christianity' is today. There is a spiritual battle going on and you are part of it whether you like it or not. We simply want you to understand the truth that is God's Word. Your eternal destiny depends upon it.
thankYou.p3: I hope if you weren't saved you now have an understanding that 'now is the day of salvation' (2 Corinthians 6:2) (KJV) and have taken the opportunity to turn to Jesus Christ and call upon Him to be saved. Romans 10:13 (KJV).
thankYou.p4: He said in Matthew 28:19a 'Go ye therefore and teach all nations...' (KJV)
thankYou.p5: I hope you will go and tell someone of the saving grace of Jesus Christ 'For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast.' (Ephesians 2:8,9) (KJV)
thankYou.p6: And His gift of Eternal Life... 'For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.' Romans 6:23 (KJV)
thankYou.p7: Jesus Christ said '... I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.' John 14:6 (KJV)
thankYou.p8: Please take advantage of the material available as the Bereans did in the New Testament in the book of ACTS.
thankYou.verse: "And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews. These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they RECEIVED the word with all readiness of mind, and SEARCHED the scriptures daily, whether those things were so. Therefore many of them BELIEVED; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few."

salvationQuiz.title: Salvation Quiz
salvationQuiz.subtitle: Answer these questions honestly to examine your understanding of salvation according to the Bible.
salvationQuiz.question: Question
salvationQuiz.savedMessage: Based on your answers, you understand and have accepted the Biblical plan of salvation. Continue to grow in your faith through prayer, Bible study, and fellowship with other believers.
salvationQuiz.notSavedMessage: Based on your answers, you may need to examine what the Bible says about salvation. Salvation is by grace through faith in Jesus Christ alone, not by works. We encourage you to read our gospel tracts to learn more about God's plan for you.
salvationQuiz.featureBibleBasedDesc: Each question is supported by Scripture from the King James Bible. Answers to the various lessons are found in the KJV Bible according to the scripture referenced or from the lesson material itself.
salvationQuiz.featurePrivateDesc: Your answers are not stored anywhere
salvationQuiz.featureEducationalDesc: Learn what the Bible says about salvation
salvationQuiz.privateInterpretationVerse: "Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation." - 2 Peter 1:20
salvationQuiz.resultsVerse: "For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast."
salvationQuiz.q1: Have you ever sinned (told a lie, stolen anything, had impure thoughts)?
salvationQuiz.v1: Romans 3:23 - For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God.
salvationQuiz.q2: Do you believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God?
salvationQuiz.v2: John 3:16 - For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
salvationQuiz.q3: Do you believe Jesus died on the cross for your sins?
salvationQuiz.v3: 1 Peter 2:24 - Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree.
salvationQuiz.q4: Do you believe Jesus rose from the dead?
salvationQuiz.v4: Romans 10:9 - If thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
salvationQuiz.q5: Have you ever personally asked Jesus Christ to save you?
salvationQuiz.v5: Romans 10:13 - For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
salvationQuiz.q6: Are you trusting in your good works to get you to heaven?
salvationQuiz.v6: Ephesians 2:8-9 - For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
salvationQuiz.q7: Are you trusting in Jesus Christ ALONE for your salvation?
salvationQuiz.v7: Acts 4:12 - Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
salvationQuiz.q8: If you died today, do you KNOW for certain you would go to heaven?
salvationQuiz.v8: 1 John 5:13 - These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may KNOW that ye have eternal life.
salvationQuiz.q9: Do you believe that eternal life is a free gift from God?
salvationQuiz.v9: Romans 6:23 - For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
salvationQuiz.q10: Have you placed your complete trust in Jesus Christ as your personal Savior?
salvationQuiz.v10: John 1:12 - But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name.

about.title: About

about.missionText2: Our mission is to provide free, high-quality gospel tracts, discipleship materials, and teaching resources to churches, missionaries, and individual believers around the world.

about.offer5Desc: Additional resources for deeper Bible study

faqs.title: Frequently Asked
faqs.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our ministry and resources.
faqs.a1: Yes! All materials on this website are completely free to download, print, and distribute. We believe the Gospel should be freely shared with everyone.
faqs.q2: Can I print and distribute these tracts?
faqs.a2: Absolutely! We encourage you to print and distribute these tracts freely. They are designed to be printed and shared with others. For best results, print on both sides and fold as indicated.
faqs.a3: We currently offer materials in English, Swahili, Luo, Kikuyu, Kalenjin, Kisii, Arabic, Amharic, Maasai, and Kamba. We are continuously working on adding more languages.
faqs.q4: How do I use the Discipleship materials?
faqs.a4: The discipleship program is designed to be completed in order. Start with Level 1 (Foundations) and work through each book. Each level builds on the previous one. You can use these for personal study or to disciple new believers.
faqs.q5: Can I use these materials in my church?
faqs.a5: Yes! Churches are welcome to use all materials for evangelism, Sunday school, Bible studies, and discipleship programs. We only ask that you don't sell them.
faqs.q6: How do I take the Salvation Quiz?
faqs.a6: Simply visit our Salvation Quiz page and answer each question honestly. The quiz is based on Bible verses and will help you examine your understanding of salvation according to Scripture.
faqs.a7: The Answer Book series is a 7-volume collection that answers common questions about Christianity, including topics like soul-winning, church issues, Christian living, false doctrines, and false religions.
faqs.q8: Can I request materials in a new language?
faqs.a8: Yes! If you would like to see materials translated into a specific language, please contact us. We are always looking for opportunities to reach more people with the Gospel.
faqs.q9: How can I support this ministry?
faqs.a9: The best way to support us is by sharing these materials with others and praying for the ministry. If you'd like to help with translations or distribution, please reach out through our contact page.
faqs.q10: Are the videos on this site original content?
faqs.a10: We feature various gospel-related videos and worship content. Some are original productions, while others are curated from trusted sources to edify and encourage believers.
faqs.stillHaveQuestionsDesc: We'd love to hear from you. Reach out and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

gospelTractsPage.howToUseDesc: God's Simple Plan of Salvation tract is a detailed explanation of the Gospel of Jesus Christ explaining how to get saved, in multiple languages. You can have someone read the tract directly from your mobile phone or print a copy and have them read from there. The content of each tract in its language is not attached. 'The God's Simple Plan of Salvation' tract is designed be used to lead someone to Christ by you reading or having them read the text and answer simple questions directly from your phone. It is best if you have the interested party read each passage for themselves and tell you what they think it means and then you explain where necessary. You can print a copy if you prefer.

nextSteps.title: What Happens
nextSteps.subtitle: Congratulations on your decision to follow Jesus! Here are 6 important steps to grow in your new faith.
nextSteps.step1Desc: The Bible is God's Word and your guide for life. Start with a translation you can understand easily.
nextSteps.step1Verse: "Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path." — Psalm 119:105
nextSteps.step1Tip1: King James Version (KJV) is traditional and trusted
nextSteps.step1Tip2: Download a Bible app on your phone
nextSteps.step1Tip3: Consider getting a physical Bible to highlight and mark
nextSteps.step2Desc: Begin reading God's Word daily. Start with the Gospel of John to learn about Jesus, then Romans to understand salvation.
nextSteps.step2Verse: "Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth." — 2 Timothy 2:15
nextSteps.step2Tip1: Read at least one chapter each day
nextSteps.step2Tip2: Start with John, then Romans, then Acts
nextSteps.step2Tip3: Keep a journal to write down what you learn
nextSteps.step3Desc: Prayer is simply talking to God. Thank Him, confess sins, ask for help, and pray for others.
nextSteps.step3Tip2: Talk to God like you would a close friend
nextSteps.step3Tip3: Use the ACTS method: Adoration, Confession, Thanksgiving, Supplication
nextSteps.step3Tip4: Don't worry about fancy words—God wants your heart
nextSteps.step4Desc: Join a Bible-believing church where you can grow, learn, and fellowship with other Christians.
nextSteps.step4Verse: "Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together." — Hebrews 10:25
nextSteps.step4Tip1: Look for a church that teaches from the Bible
nextSteps.step4Tip2: Find one that believes Jesus is the only way to salvation
nextSteps.step4Tip3: Visit a few churches to find where you feel at home
nextSteps.step5Desc: Baptism is your public declaration of faith in Jesus Christ. It symbolizes your old life dying and new life beginning.
nextSteps.step5Verse: "Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead, even so we also should walk in newness of life." — Romans 6:4
nextSteps.step5Tip1: Talk to a pastor at your church about baptism
nextSteps.step5Tip2: Baptism doesn't save you—it's a testimony of your salvation
nextSteps.step5Tip3: Invite friends and family to witness your baptism
nextSteps.step6Desc: Tell others what Jesus has done for you! Your testimony is powerful and can lead others to Christ.
nextSteps.step6Verse: "Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature." — Mark 16:15
nextSteps.step6Tip1: Start by sharing with family and friends
nextSteps.step6Tip2: Tell your personal testimony—what God has done for you
nextSteps.step6Tip3: Share gospel tracts with people you meet
nextSteps.encouragementDesc: God is with you every step of the way. The Holy Spirit lives within you to guide, comfort, and strengthen you.
nextSteps.encouragementVerse: "Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ."
